activation_policy: A canonical spell enters timed casting only when duration and each accepted interruption branch are evidence-bearing. Unresolved timing or interruption semantics fail closed.

timer_ownership.clock: monotonic integer world tick supplied by the host runtime
timer_ownership.ordering: completion tick ascending, then cast ID ordinal-ignore-case
timer_ownership.persistence: pending cast timers are temporary and are not persisted until save semantics are independently promoted

invariants: completion is explicit after timer readiness

assumptions: Promoted spell identity and effect magnitude do not establish cast duration, concentration windows, or interruption causes.
canonical_policies.safe_fallback: Reject timed cast creation and every interruption branch until exact duration and interruption evidence are promoted.
canonical_policies.runtime_impact: Prevents instant-cast approximation and unsupported cancellation behavior.
canonical_policies.character_save_impact: No pending cast state is written.
canonical_policies.world_state_impact: No effect or resource mutation occurs when timing is unresolved.

runtime_ownership.combat_spells: Owns cast IDs, timer scheduling, state transitions, interruption validation, and deterministic transition traces.
runtime_ownership.character_npc: Owns actor availability, resource balances, and persistent save mutation.
runtime_ownership.effect_execution: Occurs only after ready-to-complete and remains delegated to the evidence-backed resolution pipeline.
